summary: Order placement on POST /v1/orders began returning HTTP 500 at ~12:12Z, ~2 minutes after order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) completed its rollout at 12:10:08Z. The deploy added a new MarginCheckValidator and removed the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(); its signature error is 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO' / 'marginProfile is null for account <n>', matching the reported derivatives (F&O) failures. The deploy is the only change correlated with onset and was never rolled back, so error_rate stayed at ~18.5% (vs ~0.2% before) through the latest data. All alternatives were excluded: latency/CPU/memory/db-pool/restarts and traffic are flat (not resource/capacity), and downstream dependencies (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway, portfolio-service, ledger-db) are healthy with zero error logs (not dependency failure). Root cause is a bad deployment in order-service.

ranked_hypotheses.title: order-service deploy dep-5101 v2.14.0 introduced a NPE-prone MarginCheckValidator for F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The v2.14.0 refactor that replaced legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with a new MarginCheckValidator left the margin profile unpublished/null for F&O orders, so MarginCheckValidator.validate() dereferences a null marginProfile and throws NullPointerException, causing POST /v1/orders to return HTTP 500. Because only F&O orders flow through the new code path, the failure is scoped to derivatives orders (~18% of traffic), and the deploy was never rolled back, so the failure persists.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 v2.14.0 deployed to order-service at 12:10:00Z, rollout complete 12:10:08Z
New MarginCheckValidator added to validation chain; legacy margin validation removed
Threshold: order-service error_rate rises 0.2% -> 18.5% in the 12:12 bucket
First MarginCheckValidator NPE logged at 12:12:31Z, only ~2.3 min after rollout
NPE 'marginProfile is null' is thrown on F&O (derivatives) orders, matching the reported derivatives-order 500s
No rollback (status live) so errors continue through 13:58Z

assumptions: The marginProfile was previously populated for F&O orders under the removed legacy path, so this is a regression in the new validator rather than a pre-existing data gap
No exogenous change to upstream margin data occurred at ~12:12 (not directly observed)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Downstream/dependency failure (portfolio/market-data providing null margin profile)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A downstream service (e.g. portfolio-service or market-data-service) stopped returning margin profiles, leaving marginProfile null and triggering the NPE.

causal_chain.claim: portfolio-service error_rate flat ~0.21% and zero ERROR logs
dep-5088 predates onset by ~2.5h with no correlated impact

assumptions: marginProfile originates from portfolio-service (dependency graph from order-service does not show an explicit portfolio/margin edge)
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: portfolio-service and all order-service downstreams (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway, ledger-db) show flat error/latency/CPU and zero error logs; dep-5088 predates onset with no impact. No upstream-provider degradation observed.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion or capacity saturation on order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU/memory/connection-pool exhaustion or traffic outgrowing capacity caused order failures.

causal_chain.claim: order-service cpu ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool ~14 conns, request_rate ~232/s all flat

ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: All resource/load metrics are flat across onset; no saturation, exhaustion, latency increase or restarts. The fault began exactly at deploy time, not with load.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Config/feature-flag change caused the failures
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A configuration or feature-flag change disabled margin-profile population or enabled the new validation path incorrectly.

causal_chain.claim: Only config change in window is notification-service email.batch_size (cfg-2101)

ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: The sole config change is on notification-service and is unrelated; order-service reported no config changes. Fault correlates with a code deployment, not a config change.

facts.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101) deployed 12:10:00Z, rollout complete 12:10:08Z, change = new MarginCheckValidator added, legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() removed.
First MarginCheckValidator NullPointerException logged at 12:12:31Z with message 'marginProfile is null', orderType=FNO.
order-service error_rate rose from ~0.2% to 18.49% at the 12:12 bucket and remained ~18% through 13:57Z.
dep-5101 status is 'live' with rolled_back_at null; no rollback occurred.
order-service cpu_pct, memory_pct, db_pool_in_use, request_rate, latency_p99_ms and restarts are all flat across the incident.
pricing-engine, exchange-gateway, portfolio-service and ledger-db are all healthy (flat error_rate, no error logs).
Only config change was notification-service email.batch_size; order-service had no config change.
api-gateway error_rate rose only to ~3.4%, consistent with propagated order-service failures.

assumptions: Under the removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(), F&O margin profiles were handled correctly, so the NPE represents a regression introduced by dep-5101 rather than a pre-existing latent data gap.
No simultaneous exogenous change affected upstream margin data at ~12:12Z (not directly observable from available telemetry).
The ~18% error rate corresponds to the F&O/derivatives subset of order traffic, consistent with the reported 'mostly derivatives orders'.

timeline.event: portfolio-service dep-5088 (v4.2.1) deployed; no subsequent impact.
order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) begins; new MarginCheckValidator added.
dep-5101 rollout complete, all pods ready.
First MarginCheckValidator NPE (marginProfile null, orderType=FNO) logged.
Same NPE errors still occurring at high volume; no rollback.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service from v2.14.0 (dep-5101) to the previous version immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: The failure began at this deploy, the deploy is still 'live' with no rollback, and persisting errors are caused by the new MarginCheckValidator code path.

recommended_actions.action: Fix MarginCheckValidator to handle a null/absent marginProfile for F&O orders (restore legacy validateMargin behavior or publish margin profiles before validation).
recommended_actions.rationale: The NPE is 'marginProfile is null for account <n>'; null handling is missing in the new validator.

recommended_actions.action: Add a regression test covering F&O order validation with an unpopulated margin profile, plus a canary/staged rollout gate that watches order-service error_rate.
recommended_actions.rationale: The change shipped straight to all pods (rollout complete) and error_rate alert fired only after ~12 minutes of failures.

recommended_actions.action: Confirm whether margin profiles for F&O accounts are populated at all (check the source of marginProfile) to ensure the fix addresses the true null source.
recommended_actions.rationale: Distinguishes a validator code bug from a missing-data dependency without blocking the rollback.

data_gaps: Exact source of 'marginProfile' for F&O orders is not shown in telemetry; the order-service dependency graph shows no explicit portfolio/margin-service edge, so where the null originates (code regression vs missing upstream data) is inferred, not proven.
No post-rollback data exists yet, so recovery after reverting dep-5101 is unverified.
ledger-db error_rate metric does not exist (only connections/cpu/disk/replication/slow_queries were available), so DB error behavior could not be checked directly; slow_queries and cpu were normal.
The single GC-pause WARN at 12:37Z and portfolio-service WARNs were not investigated further as they do not correlate with onset.

findings.statement: order-service began throwing NullPointerException in MarginCheckValidator.validate at 12:12:31Z (first occurrence), with dominant patterns 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO' and 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>'.
order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% (buckets 11:30–12:05) to 18.49% in the 12:12 bucket and stayed elevated (~17.9–18.97%) through 13:57, with no recovery.
The errors continue at high volume through the latest data: 12:59–13:59 window logged 238 ERROR entries, same MarginCheckValidator NPE patterns first_seen 12:59:08.

Deployment dep-5101 was NOT rolled back: status 'live', rolled_back_at null. The only other recent deployment was portfolio-service dep-5088 at 09:36 (dependency bumps, grpc 1.62->1.63), which predates onset by ~2.5h and was followed by no impact.

order-service resource/load metrics are flat across the incident: cpu_pct ~40%, memory_pct ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14 connections, request_rate ~232 req/s, latency_p99 ~150ms, restarts 0 — no saturation, exhaustion or restart.
